capabilities.description: Represent required, allowed, and forbidden change surfaces plus tests, symbols, dependencies, deletion authority, and change budgets.
Compare observed patch facts with the intent contract, compute alignment/drift, and fail closed on hard violations or excessive drift.
Evaluate a machine-readable patch/intent envelope from an installed command with non-zero refusal semantics.
Derive changed files, status, additions/deletions, and changed symbols directly from a real git diff/worktree instead of requiring a prebuilt JSON observation envelope.
Translate issue/PR requirements, forbidden surfaces, architectural constraints, and expected tests into a versioned intent contract with provenance.
Re-evaluate the evolving patch as agent changes accumulate and surface drift before the final patch is produced.
Bind required-test observations to real test command execution and exact run receipts rather than caller-supplied status values.
Evaluate the system against an independently labeled corpus of aligned and misaligned patches to measure false allows, false refuses, and review utility.
